rules.ground: iso floor / grass tiles (override-curated; not auto-classified yet)
rules.residential: building-like fills that are neither industrial nor commercial
rules.industrial: gray/black-heavy tall or wide warehouse-like masses
rules.exclude: yellow fills, full-canvas junk, flat leftovers, overrides
rules.tier: 0=hut/low … 3=landmark; heuristic from tag+bbox_h (>=80 → 3; commercial 52..79 → 2); optional overrides.tiers
rules.unlock: min_pop/ind/com/env/sec/tra gates for map placement (#79); optional overrides.unlocks
rules.needed_characters: JPEXS Needed Characters (transitive PlaceObject graph from FFDec swf2xml)
rules.dependent_characters: JPEXS Dependent Characters (sprites that instance this clip, transitive)
rules.placeable_hint: false when other sprites depend on this clip (child module); mc* exports stay true
rules.role: spawn_library | library_primary | building_module | deco_subpart | standalone | ui | other
rules.pool_eligible: true only for mcHouse1/2/3 library-frame primaries with a building tag
rules.library_ref: mcHouse library frame index when role=library_primary
rules.building_class: former building tag kept when a module is demoted to exclude
